title: Maximum static friction
description: Essential: Correctly calculates maximum static friction as 6 N using Hooke's Law with the 3 cm extension at motion onset.

title: Sliding friction force
description: Essential: Correctly calculates sliding friction as 5 N using Hooke's Law with the 2.5 cm extension at constant velocity.

title: Coefficient of kinetic friction
description: Essential: Correctly calculates μ = 0.25 using f = μN with normal force N = mg.

title: Force equilibrium reasoning
description: Important: Recognizes that maximum static friction equals spring force when motion just begins.

title: Dynamic equilibrium condition
description: Important: Recognizes that at constant velocity, sliding friction equals spring force.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Converts cm to m correctly in Hooke's Law calculations.

title: Confusing static and kinetic
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong spring extension (e.g., 11 cm instead of 3 cm extension) for static friction calculation.

title: Incorrect normal force
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong normal force (e.g., mg - spring vertical component) despite horizontal-only setup.
